effect.name: Sangue escorrendo
effect.desc: O texto (ou qualquer forma) vira sangue escorrendo: gotas que descem, corpo brilhante, bisel e reflexos — o template Bleed do After Effects.
effect.desc-en: Turns text (or any shape) into dripping blood: falling drips, glossy body, bevel and reflections — After Effects' Bleed template.
